title: Odd Hadwiger number and graph products
summary: The Odd Hadwiger number of a graph $G$ is the largest integer $r$ such that $G$ has a clique of size $r$ as an odd minor. In this paper, we investigate how large is the Odd Hadwiger number of the product of two graphs, when considering any of the four standard graph products: Cartesian, direct, lexicographic, strong. We provide an optimal lower bound in the cases of the strong and lexicographic products.
